item.title: MapQuest hits No. 1 on App Store after refusing to rename Lake Ontario
item.description: MapQuest topped ChatGPT as Apple's most-downloaded free app after the digital mapping company said it would keep "historical, familiar" lake names.

item.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides
item.description: The House Ethics Committee detailed the North Carolina Republican's "unprofessional and inappropriate conduct" toward two young women who worked for him.

item.title: Trump says Venezuelan oil could replenish depleted U.S. stockpiles. Will it?
item.description: President Trump framed last week's deal for the U.S. government to take a stake in Venezuelan oil as a boon for the depleted Strategic Petroleum Reserve. But the plan faces some hurdles, experts say.

item.title: Why did Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resign?
item.description: The White House has confirmed that Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is resigning. The move comes after months of friction between him and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Marine veteran and former CIA officer Elliot Ackerman joins with analysis.

item.title: Jordan intercepts Iranian missiles as Trump vows more strikes on Iran
item.description: U.S. forces launched new strikes Tuesday on targets connected to Iran's Revolutionary Guard, marking another round of attacks this week as the U.S. and Iran return to hostilities.

item.title: House adopts resolution condemning socialism, with 8 Democrats joining Republicans

item.description: Erin Piacenti was identified as one of the two people stabbed by a woman Monday afternoon in Times Square before police shot and killed the suspect.

item.title: Pa. police officer charged​ after fatally shooting student at wrong home
item.description: Upper Pottsgrove Police Cpl. Sean Farrell was charged with voluntary manslaughter in the fatal shooting of Glenwood Earl Pysher IV on Aug. 23, officials said.

item.title: State Department spokesman on latest U.S. strikes against Iran, Venezuela oil deal and more
item.description: The U.S. launched new strikes against Iran on Tuesday after tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz. State Department Spokesman Tommy Pigott joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Trump and Iran trade threats after latest U.S. strikes
item.description: The U.S. conducted more strikes against Iran on Tuesday after two tankers were targeted in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump took to social media to threaten the regime that they will be hit much harder if they retaliate. CBS News senior White House correspondent Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: What it would take for judge in Lindsay Clancy case to declare mistrial
item.description: The jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial informed the judge Tuesday morning that they were unable to reach a unanimous verdict, setting up a potential mistrial. Deliberations are set to resume on Wednesday. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul and Caroline Polisi have the latest.

item.title: Grand Canyon trail guide discusses deadly flash floods, 1 person still missing
item.description: First responders recovered the bodies of two people after a major flash flood swept through the Grand Canyon last weekend. Scores of visitors were rescued by helicopter and officials say one person was still unaccounted for as of Monday evening. Nina Rehfeld, a wilderness first responder and co-owner of Grand Canyon Journeys, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial jury deadlocked, leaves for day without verdict
item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial told the judge Tuesday morning they are deadlocked, and left a Massachusetts courtroom hours later without reaching a verdict.

item.title: Trump meets with oil executives to discuss ways to lower fuel prices
item.description: President Trump on Tuesday met with oil executives to discuss how to lower fuel prices as Americans face high travel costs for the Labor Day weekend. CBS News correspondent Natalie Brand reports.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran against retaliation for latest U.S. strikes
item.description: President Trump threatened more attacks on Iran on Tuesday. In a Truth Social post, he said, "If the failed Nation of Iran retaliates for this very justified attack, they will be hit again at a much harder and higher level." CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

item.title: Tropical Storm Edouard makes landfall in Louisiana, brings heavy rain to Texas
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall in Louisiana Tuesday afternoon, and is also forecast to bring heavy rain to Texas, the National Hurricane Center said.

item.title: What happens next in Lindsay Clancy trial with jury deliberations set to continue for 5th day
item.description: Jurors in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial went home on Tuesday without reaching a verdict after saying that they were deadlocked earlier in the day. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul and Rebecca Roiphe have the latest.

item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial was dismissed for the day Tuesday afternoon, hours after telling the judge in the case they were deadlocked. They'll resume deliberations for a fifth day on Wednesday. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has more.

item.description: CBP informed Gregory Bovino in an email on March 2 that the agency was "conducting an official Inquiry into allegations of misconduct reported to CBP." He initiated retirement 16 days later.

item.title: Melinda French Gates: It Took Three Doctors to Diagnose My Perimenopause
item.description:
Melinda French Gates is focusing her money and attention on improving women's healthcare in America. In Healthful's first episode, French Gates tells Norah O'Donnell why it took three doctors to catch her perimenopause and shares the three simple things that keep her healthier than ever.

item.title: The Rise of Lung Cancer in Women and Never-Smokers
item.description:
Lung cancer has surpassed breast cancer as the leading cause of cancer deaths in American women — and a growing share of new cases are in women who have never touched a cigarette. Anne Wojcicki's sister, former YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki, was one of them. In this episode of Healthful, Norah O'Donnell sits down with Anne, Dr. Kim Sandler, Director of the Vanderbilt Lung Screening Program, and Shira Kupperman Boehler — a lifelong nonsmoker and daily runner diagnosed with lung cancer at 44 — to discuss why lung cancer is becoming one of the most urgent, and least understood, threats to women's health.

item.title: Sanjay Gupta's prescription for fighting off dementia
item.description: The neurosurgeon, CNN commentator and author of "Keep Sharp: Build a Better Brain at Any Age" has long studied the brain and the onset of Alzheimer's. He talks with CBS News chief medical correspondent Dr. Jon LaPook about the recommended steps to a healthier brain, from diet and exercise to the value of sleep and social interaction.
